exhibits.title: Lockkeeper Ilva Reyn
exhibits.subtitle: Warden of the Straight Channel
exhibits.text:
You have climbed from the Hall of Diffusion, and that is the right way in, everything here is a re-answer to a question you already know. Down there, generation asks 'what noise was added? remove a little, re-noise, repeat', and the answer is walked back along a curved path that a schedule of βs and ᾱs decides for you.

The Riverworks asks a different question at the same moment: 'I am somewhere on a path from noise to data, which DIRECTION do I move?' Answer that everywhere and you have a velocity field; generation becomes the plain act of following it. And if you are free to choose the path, choose the straight one, because a straight path has constant velocity, and constant velocity forgives enormous steps.

That is the whole floor. A straight line, its derivative, and the courage to take ten steps where a thousand were taken before.

exhibits.title: This Floor, Flow Matching
exhibits.text:
Flow matching learns a VELOCITY FIELD, and generation is an ODE solve along it. The recipe is startlingly short:

  path      x_t = (1−t)·x₀ + t·x₁      a straight line, noise to data
  velocity  v   = x₁ − x₀              constant; just data minus noise
  training  minimise ‖(x₁ − x₀) − v_θ(x_t, t)‖²
  sampling  x ← x + v_θ(x, t)·Δt,  integrate t from 0 to 1

There is no β schedule, no ᾱ table, no square roots. Five chambers open from this atrium: the straight path and the velocity it implies; the training loop; the count of steps; the network, which turns out to be the diffusion denoiser unchanged; and the practitioner's chamber of plateaus and traps. Read them in order.

One warning that has cost real debugging hours: on this floor **t = 0 is noise and t = 1 is data**, the opposite of the diffusion wing's indexing. Papers differ. Always check.

exhibits.title: How to Walk This Floor
exhibits.text:
Move with W A S D; look with the mouse. Walk up to any display and press E to study it, diagrams and figures unfold large in the room. E or Esc steps back. M: this floor's map. G: the constellation of every idea in the palace. F: travel to any room by name. N: music. P: footstep trails.

Two passages leave this floor besides the stair you climbed. An ARCHWAY joins the Swappable Engine to the Wing of the Reforged Transformer, a sideways step, because a DiT is a sibling of this art, not a parent of it. And a STAIR rises to the Hall of Embodied Motion, the highest floor in the palace, where this velocity field is asked to move a real arm. The Gatekeeper on that stair asks about the straight path, the velocity, and the count of steps. The three things this floor exists to teach.
